source: U.S. Naval Observatory Astronomical Applications Department, Dates of Primary Phases of the Moon
procedure: The four primary phase times spanning July 2026 were transcribed from the USNO year table. Values are published to the nearest minute and were not adjusted to orb.js output.
timeScale: Universal Time as reported by USNO, represented as UTC ISO strings
frame: USNO geocentric primary-phase definition; frame details are internal to the service
accuracy: Independent almanac reference rounded to one minute; orb.js uses its own Moon, Sun, and frame models.
